title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - RangeDescriptor
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/RangeDescriptor. In the case of a get service of a profile generic class a selective access can be specified. This indicates the range of values to be retrieved from the profile generic class. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own SelectiveAccess.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'RangeDescriptor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

obtainFromValue.description: Property. It restricts the range of entries to be retrieved from a profile generic, defining the oldest or smallest entry to retrieve; represented here as a string since its range varies with the captured object's own datatype.

obtainToValue.description: Property. It restricts the range of entries to be retrieved from a profile generic, defining the newest or largest entry to retrieve; represented here as a string since its range varies with the captured object's own datatype.
